sentences.en: When people use the word "ironic", they may mean "comically incongruous".
sentences.zh: 当人们使用“讽刺”这个词时，他们可能指的是‘滑稽的不协调’。

sentences.en: He has an incongruous sounding name which is hard to remember.
sentences.zh: 他有一个听起来很不搭的名字，很难记住。

sentences.en: The modern furniture looks incongruous in the old house.
sentences.zh: 现代家具放在老房子里显得不协调。

senses.zh: 不协调的，不一致的,不和谐的,不相称的,异向
